read.en: Bloom Energy fell 3.4% on Nov 2 to $196.25, trading between $194.87 and $210.09. It is below the falling 5-day ($213.7), 10-day ($214.5), 30-day ($250.8) and 100-day ($245.2) averages and the rising 200-day ($221.6). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 8 and below zero, histogram widening again; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 28 ($191.51), and RSI is 38.
read.zh: Bloom Energy 11月2日下跌 3.4%，收于 $196.25，盘中区间 $194.87–210.09。股价位于下行的 5 日（$213.7）、10 日（$214.5）、30 日（$250.8）和 100 日均线（$245.2）以及上行的 200 日均线（$221.6）下方。MACD 自 10月8日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图再度放大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月28日起看多（$191.51），RSI 为 38。

read.en: The session reached $210.1 but faded, closing under the Sep 1 low ($197.5); the Oct 30 low ($194.15) held. Resistance is $210.1–210.9 (Nov 2 and Oct 26 highs), then $213.7–214.5 (5 and 10-day) and $219.0–221.6 (Oct 29 low, 200-day). Support is $194.2–194.9, then $189–191.5 (Oct 23 low, SAR) and $185.9 (Aug 24 low). A close above $214.5 would target $221.6; below $189, $185.9.
